e.title: 链梯法验证三层：先对齐已发表的 Taylor–Ashe 三角（把 Mack 1993 手算的八个发展因子复现到 4 位小数、把 England–Verrall 2002 的总额 18,680,856 复现到个位），再用一个不共享任何代码的独立朴素实现对照，最后用已知真值做回测
e.title_en: Three layers of chain-ladder validation: reproduce the published Taylor-Ashe triangle to four decimals and the published total reserve of 18,680,856 to the unit, then compare against an independent naive implementation sharing no code, then backtest against known truth
e.title_hk: 鏈梯法驗證三層：先對齊已發表的 Taylor–Ashe 三角（把 Mack 1993 手算的八個發展因子復現到 4 位小數、把 England–Verrall 2002 的總額 18,680,856 復現到個位），再用一個不共享任何代碼的獨立樸素實現對照，最後用已知真值做回測
e.summary: 一份健康险精算引擎，解决两件事：**已发生未报告（IBNR）准备金**与**把已完成的理赔经验换成保费率（小团体定价）**，并输出精算师真正会传阅的 Excel 展表（含发展因子与累计发展因子的三角、两种方法的 IBNR 汇总、趋势、费率构成与信度表）；**其最值得记的一处是它的验证设计**——**它明确说「因为准备金 bug 是安静的」，所以做了**三层验证****：**① 对齐**已发表的教科书三角**：仓库里存着 Taylor & Ashe（1983）的 10×10 已付三角，**引擎须把 Mack（1993，ASTIN Bulletin 23(2)）**手算**的体积加权发展因子复现到 4 位小数（`3.4906, 1.7473, 1.4574, 1.1739, 1.1038, 1.0863, 1.0539, 1.0766, 1.0177`），**并把 England & Verrall（2002，British Actuarial Journal 8）发表的链梯终极值与总准备金 **18,680,856** 复现到个位**，**且出处**写在 fixture 文件内部**；**② 一个**刻意朴素、与引擎不共享任何代码**的独立实现（`eval/naive_oracle.py`）作为对照，最大相对偏差写进 `results/validation.json`**；**③ 对**已知真值**做回测**：**因为数据是合成的、每条索赔都被跑到终结，真实终极值与真实 IBNR 是精确已知的**，于是「真回测」成为可能**；**此外它给出三处非常具体的诚实说明**：**回测误差率应读作下界而非生产环境所见**；**Bornhuetter-Ferguson 在本回测中输给链梯法（MAPE 7.8–13.0% 对 3.8–7.4%）且系统性偏低（−4.7 至 −12.8%），并逐字归因于**自己的先验**（只用 13 个完全发展期拟合的对数线性趋势低估了近月）**；**以及 Excel 往返精确性被定义在「工作簿的规范精度」上，**原因是 openpyxl 以 `%.16g` 序列化浮点、无法往返完整的 17 位有效双精度**
e.summary_hk: 一份健康險精算引擎，解決兩件事：**已發生未報告（IBNR）準備金**與**把已完成的理賠經驗換成保費率（小團體定價）**，並輸出精算師真正會傳閱的 Excel 展表（含發展因子與累計發展因子的三角、兩種方法的 IBNR 匯總、趨勢、費率構成與信度表）；**其最值得記的一處是它的驗證設計**——**它明確說「因為準備金 bug 是安靜的」，所以做了**三層驗證****：**① 對齊**已發表的教科書三角**：倉庫裡存着 Taylor & Ashe（1983）的 10×10 已付三角，**引擎須把 Mack（1993，ASTIN Bulletin 23(2)）**手算**的體積加權發展因子復現到 4 位小數（`3.4906, 1.7473, 1.4574, 1.1739, 1.1038, 1.0863, 1.0539, 1.0766, 1.0177`），**並把 England & Verrall（2002，British Actuarial Journal 8）發表的鏈梯終極值與總準備金 **18,680,856** 復現到個位**，**且出處**寫在 fixture 文件內部**；**② 一個**刻意樸素、與引擎不共享任何代碼**的獨立實現（`eval/naive_oracle.py`）作為對照，最大相對偏差寫進 `results/validation.json`**；**③ 對**已知真值**做回測**：**因為數據是合成的、每條索賠都被跑到終結，真實終極值與真實 IBNR 是精確已知的**，於是「真回測」成為可能**；**此外它給出三處非常具體的誠實說明**：**回測誤差率應讀作下界而非生產環境所見**；**Bornhuetter-Ferguson 在本回測中輸給鏈梯法（MAPE 7.8–13.0% 對 3.8–7.4%）且系統性偏低（−4.7 至 −12.8%），並逐字歸因於**自己的先驗**（只用 13 個完全發展期擬合的對數線性趨勢低估了近月）**；**以及 Excel 往返精確性被定義在「工作簿的規範精度」上，**原因是 openpyxl 以 `%.16g` 序列化浮點、無法往返完整的 17 位有效雙精度**
e.summary_en: A health-plan actuarial engine covering two things: incurred-but-not-reported (IBNR) reserving, and turning completed claims experience into a premium rate for small-group pricing, while also writing the Excel exhibits an actuary would actually circulate (triangles with development and cumulative factors, an IBNR summary for both methods, trend, a rate build-up and a credibility table); **its most notable feature is its validation design** — **it says plainly that reserving bugs are quiet, so it builds three layers**: **first, alignment against a published textbook triangle**, with the Taylor & Ashe (1983) 10x10 paid triangle stored in the repository, where the engine must reproduce the volume-weighted age-to-age factors **hand-computed in Mack (1993), ASTIN Bulletin 23(2)**, to four decimals — 3.4906, 1.7473, 1.4574, 1.1739, 1.1038, 1.0863, 1.0539, 1.0766, 1.0177 — **and reproduce the chain-ladder ultimates and total reserve of 18,680,856 published in England and Verrall (2002), British Actuarial Journal 8, exactly to the unit, with the sources cited inside the fixture file**; **second, comparison against a deliberately plain independent implementation that shares no code with the engine**, whose maximum relative deviation is written to a committed results file; **and third, a backtest against known truth** — **because the data is synthetic and every claim is run to completion, the true ultimates and true IBNR are known exactly, which makes a real backtest possible**; **it also gives three very specific honest statements**: the backtest error rates should be read as a lower bound rather than what production would show; Bornhuetter-Ferguson loses to chain-ladder in this backtest (MAPE 7.8 to 13.0 percent against 3.8 to 7.4 percent) and runs biased low between minus 4.7 and minus 12.8 percent, **attributed verbatim to its own prior**, a log-linear trend fitted on only the 13 fully-developed origins; **and Excel round-trip exactness is defined at the workbook’s canonical precision, because openpyxl serialises floats with `%.16g` and cannot round-trip a full 17-significant-digit double**
e.body:
**ratecraft-reserving-pricing**（仓库 `Mohith26/emblemhealth-actuarial-pricing-reserving`，工具名 RateCraft）**是一份健康险精算引擎**：**解决「已发生未报告（IBNR）准备金」与「把已完成的理赔经验变成小团体保费率」两件事**，**并写出精算师真正会传阅的 Excel 展表**（**逐字含** **「triangles with development factors, IBNR summaries, trend, a rate buildup, and a credibility table」**）。**实测 ★0、fork 0、许可 **NONE**（**实测该仓库无任何许可文件**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 68 KB、创建 2026-08-19、最后推送 2026-09-08、topics 为 `actuarial`／`chain-ladder`／`credibility`／`health-insurance`／`ibnr`／`openpyxl`／`pandas`／`pricing`／`python`／`reserving`**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内**）；**README 实测 7,533 字节**；**仓库实测共 39 个条目（31 个文件、8 个目录）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「标准答案要放在被检验的系统之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四条里**把这件事做成三层结构的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它先说明为什么需要三层验证，理由只有一句**——**逐字为**：**「## Validation** Three layers, **because reserving bugs are quiet**:」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**「因为准备金的 bug 是安静的」**——**⭐ 这句是全部验证设计的动机**：**准备金算错不会当场报错、也不会明显偏离，**它只是安静地错下去****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里对「为什么必须找外部答案」给出的最有力的理由**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第一层是**已发表的教科书三角**，而它把两个外部数字的精度都写明了**——**这是本轮主题的核心一例**：**逐字为**：**「**A published textbook triangle.** `tests/fixtures/taylor_ashe.json` is the **Taylor & Ashe (1983)** 10x10 paid triangle. The engine reproduces the volume-weighted age-to-age factors **hand-computed in Mack (1993), ASTIN Bulletin 23(2)**（**3.4906, 1.7473, 1.4574, 1.1739, 1.1038, 1.0863, 1.0539, 1.0766, 1.0177**）**exactly to 4 decimals**, and the chain-ladder ultimates and **total reserve of 18,680,856 published in England & Verrall (2002), British Actuarial Journal 8**, **exactly to the unit**. **Sources are cited inside the fixture file.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两个参照值都来自**外部已发表的文献**，**而「手算」这个词被明确写出**（**Mack 1993 的因子是**手算**的**）**——**⭐ 即**标准答案不是自己算的，是别人算过并发表的****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **精度被逐项写明**（**因子到 4 位小数、总准备金到个位**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所见**对「复现」最不含糊的一种表述**：**不说「结果接近」，而是**给出必须相等到的位数****；**③ ⭐⭐ **出处写在 fixture 文件内部**（**⭐ 本词条**实测该文件**，其 `source` 字段**逐字引用了三篇文献**并写明「as reproduced and **hand-computed** in Mack」**）**——**⭐ 即**参照值与其出处**同处一个文件**，不能被分开****；**④ **它点名了两个不同来源各自负责不同的量**（**因子来自 Mack 1993、终极值与总额来自 England & Verrall 2002**）**——**⭐ 即**不是笼统说「参照文献」，而是**指出哪个数出自哪一篇****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其实测 fixture 文件是本会话所见「参照答案最完整的一次落盘」**——**本词条**实测读取** `tests/fixtures/taylor_ashe.json`**，**其内容为**：**`source` 字段逐字含「Taylor, G.C. & Ashe, F.R. (1983), Second moments of estimates of outstanding claims, Journal of Econometrics 23. Incremental paid triangle as reproduced and hand-computed in Mack, T. (1993), Distribution-free calculation of the standard error of chain ladder reserve estimates, ASTIN Bulletin 23(2) … and England, P.D. & Verrall, R.J. (2002), Stochastic claims reserving in general insurance, British Actuarial Journal 8 (chain-ladder ultimates; total reserve 18,680,856).」**；**其字段**逐项为** **`incremental_paid`（**真实的 10×10 三角数字**）、`published_ata_factors_4dp`（**九个已发表因子，4 位小数**）、`published_ultimates`（**十个已发表终极值**）、`published_total_reserve: 18680856`、`latest_diagonal_total: 34358090`**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它把**原始三角、已发表的中间量、已发表的结论量三者放在同一个文件里**——**⭐ 即**读者能看出引擎是对齐了**哪一层****（**⭐ 这与上一轮 [[kong-insurance-api-bundle]] 的「声明与文件清单互相印证」同一族，但这里是**数值层**）；**② ⭐⭐ **连「最新对角线的合计」也一并存下**（**34,358,090**）**——**⭐ 即**连**用哪个输入**都固定住了**；**③ **出处引到**期刊、卷期**（**Journal of Econometrics 23／ASTIN Bulletin 23(2)／British Actuarial Journal 8**）**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **第二层是**不共享任何代码的独立实现****——**逐字为**：**「**An independent naive implementation.** `eval/naive_oracle.py` is a **deliberately plain pure-Python loop version of chain-ladder that shares no code with the engine**. The two are compared on the textbook triangle plus 50 synthetic ones; **the maximum relative deviation is reported in `results/validation.json`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「刻意朴素」与「不共享任何代码」是两个并列的要求****——**⭐ 即**第二个实现的价值**来自它与第一个**没有共同的错误来源****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是「独立实现」这一做法里最关键的一句：**若两者共享代码，重复计算并不能发现同类错误****）；**② **对照规模写明**（**教科书三角 ＋ 50 个合成三角**）；**③ **结果落在**已提交的 `results/validation.json`** 里**（**⭐ 本词条**实测该文件存在**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三层是**对已知真值的回测**，而它把「合成数据的劣势」翻成了优势**——**逐字为**：**「**A backtest against known truth.** The generator splits each origin month’s true ultimate across payment lags with a **Dirichlet draw**, so incremental payments **sum exactly to the true ultimate**. `eval/backtest.py` generates 200 seeded datasets (3 lines of business, 36 origin months), truncates each at the valuation diagonal, estimates IBNR with both methods, and scores against truth: **MAPE, median APE, bias, and the share of datasets where the true ultimate lands within 10 percent of the estimate**. Numbers in `results/backtest.json` and RESULTS.md, **including the ones that are unflattering**.」**；**并在此前逐字说明这一设计的来源**：**「Real claims data is PHI, so the generator in `datagen/` simulates it instead, and **that turns out to be a feature: because the simulation runs every claim to completion, the true ultimates and true IBNR are known exactly, which makes a real backtest possible**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「合成数据的缺点变成了优点」被逐字写出**——**因为模拟把每条索赔跑到终结，**真实终极值与真实 IBNR 是精确已知的**，于是**真回测**才可能****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题最重要的一处**：**标准答案之所以能存在，是因为它被**构造**出来了，而不是被估计出来的****；**② **回测的**四个评分指标**被逐项列出**（**MAPE、中位绝对百分比误差、偏差、以及真值落在估计值 10% 内的数据集占比**）**；**③ **规模写明**（**200 个带种子的数据集、3 条业务线、36 个发生月**）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「including the ones that are unflattering」**（**包括那些不好看的**）**——**⭐ 即**结果文件里**不做筛选****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **Excel 展表的精确性定义，连同其**技术原因**一起给出**——**逐字为**：**「Numeric cells use a **canonical precision**（dollars to the cent, factors to 8 decimals）**because openpyxl serializes floats with `%.16g`, which cannot round-trip a full 17-significant-digit double**. At that precision the tests reopen the workbook and **assert every cell equals engine output with `==`, no tolerance**. A deterministic sample (seed 42) is committed at `examples/sample_exhibits.xlsx`.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「精确相等、不用容差」与「精度是有限度的」同时成立**——**理由是**一个具名的库行为**（**openpyxl 的 `%.16g` 无法往返完整的 17 位有效双精度**）**——**⭐ 即**它先把**不可精确的范围**说清，**再在**可说清的范围内要求完全相等****；**② ⭐⭐ **测试会**重新打开工作簿**逐格比对**（**⭐ 即**验证对象是**落盘后的文件**，而不是内存里的中间值**）；**③ **规范精度给出**具体位数**（**金额到分、因子到 8 位小数**）；**④ **一份确定性的样例工作簿被提交**（**`examples/sample_exhibits.xlsx`，seed 42**，**⭐ 本词条**实测该文件存在**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **费率构成是六步链，且每一步都要被**回算到分****——**逐字为**：**「then develops a small-group rate through a **six-step chain where every intermediate is stored and reconciled back to the cent**（`reconcile` recomputes each step from the inputs; **the invariant is that every difference is 0 cents**）」**，**六步逐字为**：**① `experience_pmpm = round(completed_claims / member_months, 2)`；② `trend_factor = (1 + annual_trend) ^ (trend_months / 12)`；③ `projected_pmpm = round(experience_pmpm * trend_factor, 2)`；④ `Z = min(1, sqrt(n / full_credibility_n))`（**经典有限波动信度**）；⑤ `blended_pmpm = round(Z * projected_pmpm + (1 - Z) * manual_pmpm, 2)`；⑥ `required_pmpm = round(blended_pmpm / target_loss_ratio, 2)`（**目标赔付率 ＝ 1 减管理附加与利润边际**）**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **不变量是「每一步的差为 0 分」**——**⭐ 即**它不是检查最终值，而是**用一个回算函数从输入重算每一步**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是「链式计算的每一步都可核对」最直接的一种实现**）；**② ⭐⭐ **公式逐条写出且**四舍五入的位置明确**（**第 1、3、5、6 步各 round 到 2 位**）**——**⭐ 即**精度损失点被写出来而不是隐含**；**③ **信度公式是**经典的**并写明其形式**（**`min(1, sqrt(n / full_credibility_n))`**）**；**④ **目标赔付率的构成被写明**（**1 减管理附加与利润边际**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「注意事项与缺口」一节是本条最值得引用的一节，因为里面有一条**把失败归因于自己**的说明**——**逐字为**：**「**Bornhuetter-Ferguson loses to chain-ladder in this backtest**（**MAPE 7.8 to 13.0 percent vs 3.8 to 7.4 percent**）**and runs biased low, between -4.7 and -12.8 percent**. **That is mostly my prior’s fault**: a log-linear trend fit to only the 13 fully-developed origins under-projects recent months. A pricing-based expected-loss-ratio prior would be the natural fix, **and I have not built or measured one**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **它主动公布了自己那个方法**输**（**两种方法的 MAPE 并列给出**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「这主要是我的先验的错」**——**⭐ 即**归因指向自己的设计选择，而不是数据或工具****；**③ **修复方向也被指出**（**改用基于定价的期望赔付率先验**）**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **并逐字说明**这个修复没有做、也没有测****——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本站所收条目里**对「我知道该怎么改但还没改」写得最清楚的一处**：**留下一个**有名有姓的缺口**，而不是一句「未来会改进」****。**⑨ ⭐⭐⭐ **另一条局限把「统计限度」与「代码缺陷」明确分开**——**逐字为**：**「Trend measurement is noisy by construction: 13 fully-runoff months with 3 to 5 percent ultimate noise plus seasonality give **mean absolute errors of 3.6 to 7.8 percentage points against the true trend**. **That is a statistical limit of the short window, not a code defect**; **exact recovery on a noise-free series is unit-tested**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「这是短窗口的统计限度，不是代码缺陷」**——**⭐ 即**它明确区分了**两类误差来源**，**并指出**其中一类不该去修代码****；**② ⭐⭐ **并且给出**证据**：**在无噪声序列上能精确恢复，这一点有单元测试**——**⭐ 即**它用**一个可运行的测试**来支持「错不在代码」这一论断**；**③ **误差幅度被量化**（**3.6 至 7.8 个百分点**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **回测误差率被明确要求当下界读**——**逐字为**：**「Everything is synthetic. The lag curves are stationary and the Dirichlet split is clean, so chain-ladder is close to well-specified on this data. **ratecraft-reserving-pricing**（倉庫 `Mohith26/emblemhealth-actuarial-pricing-reserving`，工具名 RateCraft）**是一份健康險精算引擎**：**解決「已發生未報告（IBNR）準備金」與「把已完成的理賠經驗變成小團體保費率」兩件事**，**並寫出精算師真正會傳閱的 Excel 展表**（**逐字含** **「triangles with development factors, IBNR summaries, trend, a rate buildup, and a credibility table」**）。**實測 ★0、fork 0、許可 **NONE**（**實測該倉庫無任何許可文件**）、主語言 Python、體量 68 KB、創建 2026-08-19、最後推送 2026-09-08、topics 為 `actuarial`／`chain-ladder`／`credibility`／`health-insurance`／`ibnr`／`openpyxl`／`pandas`／`pricing`／`python`／`reserving`**（**創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內**）；**README 實測 7,533 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 39 個條目（31 個文件、8 個目錄）**。本條目屬本輪主題**「標準答案要放在被檢驗的系統之外」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是四條裡**把這件事做成三層結構的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它先說明為什麼需要三層驗證，理由只有一句**：**「## Validation** Three layers, **because reserving bugs are quiet**:」**⭐⭐⭐ **即**「因為準備金的 bug 是安靜的」**——**⭐ 這是全部驗證設計的動機**：**準備金算錯不會當場報錯、也不會明顯偏離，它只是安靜地錯下去****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **第一層是**已發表的教科書三角**，而它把兩個外部數字的精度都寫明了**：**「**A published textbook triangle.** `tests/fixtures/taylor_ashe.json` is the **Taylor & Ashe (1983)** 10x10 paid triangle. The engine reproduces the volume-weighted age-to-age factors **hand-computed in Mack (1993), ASTIN Bulletin 23(2)**（**3.4906, 1.7473, 1.4574, 1.1739, 1.1038, 1.0863, 1.0539, 1.0766, 1.0177**）**exactly to 4 decimals**, and the chain-ladder ultimates and **total reserve of 18,680,856 published in England & Verrall (2002), British Actuarial Journal 8**, **exactly to the unit**. **Sources are cited inside the fixture file.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 兩個參照值都來自**外部已發表的文獻**，而「手算」這個詞被明確寫出**（Mack 1993 的因子是**手算**的）——**⭐ 即**標準答案不是自己算的，是別人算過並發表的****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 精度被逐項寫明**（因子到 4 位小數、總準備金到個位）——**⭐ 這是本站所見**對「復現」最不含糊的一種表述**：不說「結果接近」，而是**給出必須相等到的位數****；**③ ⭐⭐ 出處寫在 fixture 文件內部**（**⭐ 本詞條**實測該文件**，其 `source` 字段逐字引用了三篇文獻並寫明「as reproduced and **hand-computed** in Mack」**）——**⭐ 即**參照值與其出處同處一個文件，不能被分開****；**④ 它點名了兩個不同來源各自負責不同的量**（因子來自 Mack 1993、終極值與總額來自 England & Verrall 2002）**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其實測 fixture 文件是本會話所見「參照答案最完整的一次落盤」**——**本詞條**實測讀取** `tests/fixtures/taylor_ashe.json`：**`source` 字段逐字含三篇文獻的期刊與卷期，並寫明「total reserve 18,680,856」**；**其字段逐項為** **`incremental_paid`（真實的 10×10 三角數字）、`published_ata_factors_4dp`（九個已發表因子，4 位小數）、`published_ultimates`（十個已發表終極值）、`published_total_reserve: 18680856`、`latest_diagonal_total: 34358090`**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它把**原始三角、已發表的中間量、已發表的結論量三者放在同一個文件裡****（**⭐ 即**讀者能看出引擎是對齊了**哪一層****）；**② ⭐⭐ 連「最新對角線的合計」也一併存下**（34,358,090）——**⭐ 即**連用哪個輸入都固定住了****；**③ 出處引到期刊、卷期**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **第二層是**不共享任何代碼的獨立實現****：**「**An independent naive implementation.** `eval/naive_oracle.py` is a **deliberately plain pure-Python loop version of chain-ladder that shares no code with the engine**. The two are compared on the textbook triangle plus 50 synthetic ones; **the maximum relative deviation is reported in `results/validation.json`**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「刻意樸素」與「不共享任何代碼」是兩個並列的要求**——**⭐ 即**第二個實現的價值來自它與第一個**沒有共同的錯誤來源****（**⭐ 若兩者共享代碼，重複計算並不能發現同類錯誤**）；**② 對照規模寫明**（教科書三角 ＋ 50 個合成三角）；**③ 結果落在**已提交的 `results/validation.json`** 裡**（**⭐ 實測該文件存在**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **第三層是**對已知真值的回測**，而它把「合成數據的劣勢」翻成了優勢**：**「**A backtest against known truth.** The generator splits each origin month’s true ultimate across payment lags with a **Dirichlet draw**, so incremental payments **sum exactly to the true ultimate**. `eval/backtest.py` generates 200 seeded datasets (3 lines of business, 36 origin months), truncates each at the valuation diagonal, estimates IBNR with both methods, and scores against truth: **MAPE, median APE, bias, and the share of datasets where the true ultimate lands within 10 percent of the estimate**. Numbers in `results/backtest.json` and RESULTS.md, **including the ones that are unflattering**.」**；**並在此前逐字說明**：**「Real claims data is PHI, so the generator in `datagen/` simulates it instead, and **that turns out to be a feature: because the simulation runs every claim to completion, the true ultimates and true IBNR are known exactly, which makes a real backtest possible**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「合成數據的缺點變成了優點」被逐字寫出**——**因為模擬把每條索賠跑到終結，真實終極值與真實 IBNR 是精確已知的，於是真回測才可能****——**⭐ 標準答案之所以能存在，是因為它被**構造**出來了，而不是被估計出來的****；**② 回測的**四個評分指標**被逐項列出**；**③ 規模寫明**（200 個帶種子的數據集、3 條業務線、36 個發生月）；**④ ⭐⭐⭐「including the ones that are unflattering」**——**结果文件里不做筛选****。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **Excel 展表的精確性定義連同其**技術原因**一起給出**：**「Numeric cells use a **canonical precision**（dollars to the cent, factors to 8 decimals）**because openpyxl serializes floats with `%.16g`, which cannot round-trip a full 17-significant-digit double**. This entry belongs to this round’s theme that **the reference answer must live outside the system being tested**; ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it is the one that builds that into three layers**.
